leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a computed property to derive state from reactive data
Construct a method that utilizes reactive dependencies for dynamic behavior
Configure a component to conditionally render elements based on reactive state
Bind event handlers to DOM elements to trigger reactive updates
Initialize reactive state using ref and computed for a functional component
Manipulate reactive state through user interactions to demonstrate reactivity
Integrate multiple reactive properties to manage component logic cohesively
